Verbatim ether.fi LRTSquared Governable: onlyGovernor reads the governor from an explicit storage slot via the internal accessor _governor(), so the gate lowers to a view_call on _governor() (no external selector). Resolution must fall back to the canonical public governor() getter (bug #4).

Faithful ether.fi L1BaseSyncPool: onMessageReceived gates on msg.sender == receivers[originEid], a mapping(uint32 => address) keyed by a function parameter inside ERC-7201 namespaced storage (claim #3 group C). There is no getter to read; resolution must enumerate the mapping's VALUE set from its ReceiverSet setter events, or surface an external check when none are observed.

Faithful ether.fi MembershipNFT: onlyMembershipManagerContract gates on msg.sender == address(membershipManager), an INTERNAL address var declared without public so its getter reverts on every deployment (claim #3 group D). Resolution must read the var's sequential storage slot via eth_getStorageAt; the public liquidityPool sibling resolves via its auto-getter and must NOT get a slot.

Verbatim Solady Ownable (as vendored by ether.fi TopUp/TopUpV2): owner lives in the bytes32 constant slot _OWNER_SLOT read via inline assembly, with canonical public getter owner(). A caller-equality gate naming _OWNER_SLOT must not become a dead role_identifier:_OWNER_SLOT target (bug #6).

ether.fi TopUp.processTopUp gate (verbatim) over the real Solady Ownable: address _owner = owner(); require(_owner == msg.sender). Reproduces the production state_variable:_OWNER_SLOT caller operand that resolution must read via owner() rather than _OWNER_SLOT() (bug #6).

OZ-v5 ERC-7201 namespaced ownership in the two etherfi forms: OzV5Ownable (OwnableUpgradeable, EtherfiL1SyncPoolETH cid 615) surfaces the suppressed OwnableStorageLocation slot constant, and OzV5AccessControlDefaultAdmin (AccessControlDefaultAdminRules with owner()=>defaultAdmin(), CumulativeMerkleDrop cid 462) inlines owner() to a view_call of the private _getAccessControlDefaultAdminRulesStorage() accessor. The owner controller and the gate principal must both resolve via owner(), never the dead slot/accessor.
UUPS positive (EETH-class): proxiableUUID sibling gates upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall for the upgrade.implementation claim.
Proxy-shell positive (wBETH-class zos): delegatecall-fallback gate recovers upgradeTo (upgrade.implementation) and changeAdmin (proxy.admin_change).
Adversarial near-miss NEGATIVE: upgradeTo/changeAdmin selectors present but no proxy gate (no proxiableUUID, delegatecall fallback, or marker event), so no upgrade/admin claim.
Safe positive (SafeL2-class): getThreshold+getOwners+execTransaction gate yields safe.signer_mgmt/module_mgmt/set_guard plus exec.arbitrary on the execute entries.
Timelock positive (OZ TimelockController): getMinDelay+schedule+execute+hashOperation gate yields per-selector timelock.* claims; execute/executeBatch also carry exec.arbitrary.
exec.arbitrary idiom positive (BoringVault.manage): a body-origin call forwarding a parameter-tainted destination and calldata, claimed at the idiom_structural tier.

Discriminating corpus for the exec.arbitrary parameter BINDING: two address params with the destination second, a state-variable destination no param reaches, three resolvable library forwarders (low-level, reversed operand order, inline assembly), a two-step forwarder that resolves to not_determined, five destinations reaching the call through a name the body defines twice (branch, reassignment, write-after-call on a param and on storage), the singly-assigned sibling that must still bind, and four multi-op bodies pinning the fragment's over-all-ops quantifier (guard-then-exec in both statement orders, an all-state-var body where the suppression still fires, and a state-var op beside a branched not_determined one).

The Safe/Zodiac transaction-guard idiom beside its open control: a mandatory nonview guard call vets the caller-supplied (target, data) before the arbitrary call, so the guarded entry's destination constraint must stay not_determined while the guardless control alone earns unconstrained_proven — the pair pins that a swallowed guard leaf can never mint the negative proof.
Adversarial taint near-miss NEGATIVE: address-tainted destination but no dynamic-bytes calldata parameter, so the value send earns no exec.arbitrary claim.
